target: 550 Effectūs Ritūāli Maris Precātiōnis

source: 550 Effects of the Sea Prayer Ritual
target: 550 Effectūs Ritūāli Maris Precātiōnis

source: Lumian hesitated, embodying the character of the adventurer—Louis Berry—
target: Lumian haesitavit, personam audācentis exploratoris —Louis Berry— incarnans.

source: grappling with the unfamiliarity of Highlander.
target: Luctans cum alienitate Highlanderis.

source: Once Lugano finished translating Noelia’s words, he nodded gently, sporting a welcoming smile as he spoke in Intisian, “Come in, please.”
target: Postquam Lugano verba Noeliae interpretatus est, leniter annuit, vultu amabili subridente, dum in lingua Intisiana loquebatur: “Intrā, quaeso.”

source: Simultaneously, he rose from his seat.
target: Simul ex sede surrexit.

source: Lugano, who had already reached the door, opened it.
target: Lugano, qui iam ad ianuam pervenerat, eam aperuit.

source: The figure outside indeed proved to be Noelia, the combat nun of the Fertility Order.
target: Figura foris vere Noelia erat, monialis pugnatrix Ordinis Fertilitatis.

source: Contrary to expectation, she wasn’t cloaked in black or adorned with religious headwear.
target: Contrā exspectationem, neque in veste nigra involuta erat neque habitu religioso ornata.

source: Her thick, black, curly hair flowed over her brown leather armor, and her lively light-blue eyes exuded energy.
target: Crines eius densi, nigri et crispati super loricam ex corio fusco factam fluēbant, et oculi eius vividi caerulei energiam efferebant.

source: Lumian noticed the pair of straight swords strapped to Noelia’s back and the revolver at her waist.
target: Lumian animadvertit par gladierum rectorum, alligatorum in tergo Noeliae, atque revolverum ad latus eius.

source: Smiling, he stepped forward.
target: Subridens accessit.

source: “Thank you for your assistance.”
target: “Gratias tibi ago pro auxilio tuo.”

source: Previously dependent on Lugano’s translation, Noelia replied in Intisian, “How did you know I was here to help?”
target: Praevia translatione Lugani innixa, Noelia in Intisiana respondit: “Quomodo scivisti me huc venisse ut auxilium ferrem?”

source: Lumian didn’t conceal his intentions for today’s performance.
target: Lumian consilia sua pro hodierna representatione non celavit.

source: He raised his hand, pointing at his head, indicating deduction.
target: Manum levavit, ad caput suum indicans, deductionem exprimens.

source: Of course, his gratitude stemmed from her aid in digesting the Conspirer potion.
target: Certe, eius gratitudo ex auxilio ejus ad potionem Conspiratoris digestam oriri videbatur.

source: Noelia’s thick eyebrows twitched approvingly as she nodded.
target: Supercilia Noeliae densa approbante motu tremuerunt, dum illa annuit.

source: Then, she turned her gaze to Lugano and Ludwig, as if seeking Lumian’s opinion on whether to have them leave.
target: Deinde, oculos suos ad Lugano et Ludwigum vertit, quasi sententiam Lumiani de eorum discessu quaerens.

source: Lugano’s expression made it clear he preferred not to be part of it.
target: Vultus Lugani clare ostendebat se non velle participare.

source: Sparing Lugano, Lumian gestured for him to take Ludwig outside, perhaps for street snacks.
target: Lugano parcens, Lumian ei signavit ut Ludovicum extra duceret, fortasse ad edulia viaria.

source: After the two departed the suite, Lumian remarked to Noelia, “You actually know Intisian. You didn’t say a word of it earlier.”
target: Postquam duo conclave reliquerunt, Lumian Noeliae edixit: “Revera linguam Intisiana nosti; neque unum verbum antea dixeris.”

source: Noelia replied with a smile, “We often take turns guarding the mountain passes in the southern foothills of the Pyraez mountain range.”
target: Noelia subridente respondit: “Saepe vicissim custodimus transitūs montium in collibus australis Pyraez.”

source: The Pyraez range, termed by the Feynapotter Kingdom, referred to the Dariège mountain range.
target: Catena montium Pyraez, a Regno Feynapotter dicta, ad montes Dariège pertinebat.

source: Shepherds frequently traversed it, entering the plains and pastures of Gaia and other provinces.
target: Pastores eam frequenter transierunt, ingrediens planities et prata Gaiae aliarumque provinciarum.

source: Without awaiting Lumian’s further inquiry, Noelia tucked her hair behind her ear and grinned.
target: Non exspectans ulteriorem interrogationem Lumiani, Noelia crines suos post auriculam condidit et subridens risit.

source: “It’s impolite to have a lady standing and chatting with you.”
target: “Non est urbanum, mulierem stantem tecum colloquens esse.”

source: Only then did Lumian invite Noelia to sit on the divan while he chose the armchair.
target: Tum demum Lumian Noeliam invitavit ut in divano consederet, dum ipse in sellā brācchiāta sedebat.

source: Noelia gazed at him and continued, “Port Santa’s sea prayer ritual dates back to the late Fourth Epoch.
target: Noelia eum intuebatur et continuavit: “Rituale maris precationis Portus Santae a proximo fine Quartae Aetatis originem habet.

source: It’s over a thousand years old and can be considered ancient.
target: Plus quam mille annos habet et antiqua esse habetur.

source: The Church once purged it, relocating all relevant insiders and purifying all participants.
target: Ecclesia olim id purgavit, internos pertinentes transferens et omnes participantes purificans.

source: However, less than a hundred years later, someone here began secretly conducting the sea prayer ritual again.”
target: Sed minus centum annos post, aliquis hic arcane rituale maris precationis iterum exsequi coepit.

source: She didn’t explain why she shared this history; it seemed like she was merely recounting.
target: Non explicavit cur hanc historiam narrasset; videbatur eam tantummodo referre.

source: “They didn’t continue purging it afterward?” Lumian inquired.
target: “Num postea illud purgare non perseveraverunt?” inquit Lumian.

source: Noelia pursed her red lips and replied with a solemn expression, “In this matter, the brass’s orders are often contradictory.
target: Noelia labra rubra contraxit et respondit, vultu solenne: “In hoc negotio, mandata a praefectis saepe sunt contradictoria.

source: Sometimes, they let our Fertility Order handle it; other times, they signal us to observe for a while.
target: Aliquando sinunt Ordinem Fertilitatis nostrum rem gerere; alias nobis signum dant ut paulisper observemus.

source: All of this has been permitted by a second-in-command Blessed.”
target: Haec omnia concessa sunt a secundo praefecto Beatō.

source: Lumian, drawing knowledge from Madam Magician, the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, and other sources, had come to understand that the Earth Mother Church operated on two major systems: Favored and Blessed.
target: Lumian, ex doctrina Dominae Magicae, Societatis Inquisitionis Simiae Crispatae, et ex aliis fontibus, intellexit Ecclesiam Matris Terrae in duobus ordinibus principalibus operari: Favored et Blessed.

source: Favored referred to Beyonders of the Earth and Moon pathways among clergymen.
target: ‘Favored’ erat appellatio ad eos, qui per vias Terrae et Lunæ inter clericos ambulabant.

source: Meanwhile, Blessed encompassed Beyonders of other pathways favored by the Earth Mother.
target: Interim, ‘Blessed’ comprehendebat eos, qui per alias semitas ab Matre Terra fovēbantur.

source: Orders from a Favored required at least one second-in-command Blessed to be valid.
target: Mandata a ‘Favored’ requirebant saltem unum sub praefectum ‘Blessed’ ad valida esse.

source: Without this, they risked being considered products of the influence of evil gods and demons.
target: Sine hoc, periclitabantur ut putarentur effectus influentiae deorum malignorum et daemonum.

source: Lumian found the Earth Mother Church’s intricate system perplexing, seemingly designed to guard against the Favored.
target: Lumian systema intricatum Ecclesiae Matris Terrae perplexum invenit, quasi destinatum ad contra ‘Favored’ tegendum.

source: Nevertheless, he believed that there must be a reason behind such complexity.
target: Tamen credidit rationem hujus complexitatis exsistere oportere.

source: Having undergone numerous experiences, he became increasingly aware that seemingly inconspicuous rules in the mystical world often held lessons etched in blood.
target: Experientiis multis affectus, paulatim intellexit regulae in mundo mystico, quamquam vix conspicuae, saepe lectiones sanguine insculptas continere.

source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian inquired, “Are you a Favored or a Blessed?”
target: Post momentum meditationis, Lumian quaesivit: “Esne Favored an Blessed?”

source: “I’m a Blessed,” Noelia replied without delving into the specifics of her pathway.
target: “Ego sum Blessed,” respondit Noelia, nec in singulis semitibus viae sui intravit.

source: Lumian nodded slightly, indicating for her to continue.
target: Lumian leviter annuit, indicans ei ut perseueraret.

source: Noelia smiled and sighed.
target: Noelia subridens suspiravit.

source: “After a long period of repetition, we eventually reached an unspoken agreement to allow the sea prayer ritual.
target: “Post longum tempus repetitionis, tandem tacita consentientia attigimus, ut rituale maris precationis concederetur.

source: At the very least, it brought prosperity to Port Santa without causing social chaos or significant disruptions beyond the participants.
target: Saltem, prosperitatem Portus Santae afferebat, nec tumultum sociale aut perturbationes notabiles extra participantes causans.

source: That decision was made ages ago, and while ancient dossiers provide a rough understanding, the exact reasons convincing matriarchs, presidents, and archbishops remain elusive.
target: Decisio illa abhinc facienda fuit, et quamquam antiquae tabulae rationem approximatam praebent, causae exactae, quae matriarcas, praesides et archiepiscopos convicerent, adhuc incertae manent.

source: Essentially, the sea prayer ritual has evolved into a traditional folklore in Port Santa, fostering prosperity in maritime trade and fisheries.”
target: Essentialiter, rituale maris precationis in popularem traditionem in Portu Santa evolutum est, prosperitatem in mercatura maritima et piscatione fovens.

source: Crossing her arms over her chest, Noelia intoned with piety, “Life’s precious embrace, the harvest’s grace.”
target: Brachia in pectore transfigurans, Noelia pietose inlitteravit: “Pretiosus amplexus vitae, gratia messis.”

source: Lumian, intrigued, narrowed his eyes and inquired, “Why did you change the prayer gesture?”
target: Lumian, studiosus, oculos contraxit et quaesivit: “Cur gestum precationis mutavisti?”

source: Is there a problem?
target: Estne quaestio?

source: Noelia opened her eyes and grinned.
target: Noelia oculos aperuit et subridens risit.

source: “This was a gesture frequently used in the past, but as Earth Mother regained some lost authority, we adopted a new posture for formal occasions.”
target: “Hic gestus olim saepe adhibitus fuit, sed cum Mater Terrae aliquam auctoritatem recuperavit, novam habitum ad occasiones formales sumpsimus.”

source: She rose, positioning her legs slightly apart, hands raised high, and passionately explained to Louis Berry as if preaching.
target: Surgens, crura paulum separata, manibus alte levatis, ardenter ad Ludovicum Berry quasi praedicans explanavit.

source: “The feet connect to the benevolent earth, and the palms reach towards the spiritual sky.
target: “Pedes ad terram benevolentem coniunguntur, et palmae ad caelum spirituale tendunt,

source: In the middle resides the light of life.
target: in medio habitat lumen vitae.

source: This is the domain of the Mother of All Things.”
target: “Hoc est regnum Matris Omnium Rerum.”

source: One can regain some of Their lost authority? Lumian was puzzled, but that wasn’t the focal point.
target: Possit aliquanta auctoritas amissa recuperari? Lumian stupefactus erat, sed id non erat punctum principale.

source: Noelia settled back into her seat and continued, “While we haven’t deciphered the core process of the sea prayer ritual, years of surveillance have yielded some insights.”
target: Noelia in suam sedem revertit et continuavit: “Cum processum cardinalem rituālis maris precationis nondum enodaverimus, anni vigilantiae nonnulla indicia profecerunt.”

source: “The Governor of the Sea, who successfully gains the sea’s favor, wields the power to control this stretch of the sea, preventing shipwrecks.
target: “Praefectus Maris, qui favorem maris efficaciter adipiscitur, potestatem habet hanc partem maris regere, naufragia prohibens,

source: However, this seemingly comes at the cost of their lives and something more.
target: sed hoc, ut videtur, eorum vitam atque aliquid additum exigit.

source: Simultaneously, the ritual triggers rapid reproduction and thriving life in the area, ensuring fishermen a bountiful harvest.
target: Simul, ritus celerem reproductionem et vitam vigentem in regione incitat, piscatoribus metum copiosum praebens.

source: It also intertwines with fate; families with Maidens of the Sea in their lineage tend to experience good fortune, not just due to preferential treatment.”
target: Etiam cum fato connexus est; familiae, in quibus in stirpe Mulieres Maris sunt, bonae fortunæ occurrere solent, non tantum ob favorem specialem.

source: The sea prayer ritual’s effects are intricate, wielding the power of the sea domain and influencing fate, reproduction, and abundance…
target: Effectūs rituālis maris precationis intricati sunt, potentiam dominii maris habentes et fatum, reproductionem, atque abundantiam afficientes…

source: Lumian struggled to grasp the reasons behind these occurrences.
target: Lumian conatus est ut rationes harum eventuum caperet.

source: Noelia peered into Lumian’s face, her eyes bright yet gentle, and said, “The committee members of the Fisheries Guild, some villagers from Milo Village, and participants in the core process of the sea prayer ritual have all acquired mystical powers.
target: Noelia in faciem Lumiani intuebatur, oculis suis lucidis sed mansuets, et dixit: “Membri commissionis Guildae Piscariorum, quidam incolae ex vico Milo, atque participantes in processu cardinali rituālis maris precationis omnes vires mysticas adepti sunt.

source: We once confronted the little devils you encountered.
target: Olim adversati sumus parvis diabolis quos invenisti.

source: When pursuing certain criminals, we discovered them transformed into lizard-like monsters.”
target: Dum certos sceleratos persequentes essemus, eos invenimus in monstra lacertiformia transformatos.

source: Humanoid lizards? Similar to the Paco family’s? Lumian hadn’t anticipated obtaining any clues from Noelia.
target: Lacertae humanoides? Similes familiae Paco? Lumian non speraverat ullas indicia a Noelia consequiturum esse.

source: Noelia smiled.
target: Noelia subridet.

source: “Later, we found a commonality among those who can transform into lizard-
target: “Postea, invenimus similitudinem inter eos, qui in lacertas —

source: like monsters.”
target: similia monstris.”

source: “What is it?” Lumian couldn’t conceal his curiosity.
target: “Quid est?” Lumian curiositatem celare non potuit.

source: Noelia replied with a faint smile, “Their mothers were once Maidens of the Sea.”
target: Noelia leniter subridente respondit: “Matres eorum olim Mulieres Maris erant.”

source: Maidens of the Sea’s children? Child of the Sea? Which of Rubió’s siblings did I kill? Not only did he transform into a humanoid lizard, but he also went mad and severely injured his mother? Lumian swiftly connected the dots, sensing he had grasped the essence of the Paco family’s commission.
target: Filia Mulierum Maris? Proles Maris? Quorum ex Rubió sororibus aut fratribus interfeci? Non solum in lacertam humanoidem transformatus est, sed etiam insanus factus est et matrem suam graviter laesit? Lumian celeriter nexus connexit, intuens se essentiam mandati familiae Paco comprehensum esse.

source: Yet, confusion crept in.
target: At confusio insidiā orta est.

source: If this information is known to families with Maidens of the Sea, why would the Paco family conceal it from Juan Oro and other committee members in the Fisheries Guild?
target: Si haec notitia nota est familiis, in quibus Mulieres Maris adsunt, cur familia Paco ab Juan Oro aliisque membris commissionis Guildae Piscariorum celaret?

source: Noelia didn’t seek his thoughts and teased, “After confirming the link between the lizard-like monsters and the sea prayer ritual, we intentionally alerted the Fisheries Guild committee members.
target: Noelia non quaesivit eius sententias et iactavit: “Postquam nexum inter monstra lacertiformia et rituale maris precationis confirmavimus, membris commissionis Guildae Piscariorum conscie nos admonuimus.

source: Since then, no such criminals have surfaced.
target: Ex tunc, nulli tam scelerati apparuerunt.

source: They show discipline and restraint.
target: Eos disciplina et temperantia ostendunt.

source: This is why, at times, I understand why the brass tacitly permit the sea prayer ritual in Port Santa.
target: Idcirco, aliquando, intellego cur duces tacite rituale maris precationis in Portus Santae permittant.

source: The participants are more obedient and easily controlled compared to adventurers like you.”
target: Participantēs magis oboedi sunt et facile moderantur, comparati ad adventores similes tibi.

source: Noelia implied: “I just advised you to stay away from the Fisheries Guild.
target: Noelia insinuavit: “Modo tibi suasi ut a Guildā Piscariorum abstineres.

source: Yet, the next day, you stormed into the Governor of the Sea’s residence, pointing a gun at Juan Oro’s head.
target: At tamen, die sequenti, in domum Praefectī Maris irruit, sclopeton ad caput Juan Oro intendens.

source: That’s much more troublesome than those involved with the sea prayer ritual!”
target: Id multo magis molestum est quam illi, qui rituale maris precationis implicati sunt!

source: Lumian smiled, choosing not to comment.
target: Lumian subridit, decernens non commentari.

source: Noelia pondered for a moment, locking eyes with him.
target: Noelia paulum meditata est, oculos cum eo iungens.

source: “I’m not sure why you’re investigating the sea prayer ritual, and I don’t want to know.
target: “Nescio quare rituale maris precationis investiges, nec cupio scire.

source: What I can say is, if your actions endanger all of Port Santa, we will step in and expel you.
target: Quod dicere possum est: si acta tua totum Portum Santa in periculum adducunt, interveniemus et te expellemus.

source: With that condition, we might offer some assistance.”
target: Hoc praesupposito, fortasse aliquod auxilium praebere possumus.

source: Lumian picked up the straw hat beside him and pressed it against his chest.
target: Lumian petasum stramineum iuxta se levavit et ad pectus suum appressit.

source: “It would be an honor.”
target: “Honos esset.”

source: Noelia left the Earth Mother Church’s objectives in this matter unspoken, and Lumian chose not to delve into it.
target: Noelia de propositis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae in hoc negotio non enuntiavit, et Lumian deliberare noluit.

source: The combat nun of the Fertility Order rose, making her way toward the door.
target: Monialis pugnatrix Ordinis Fertilitatis surrexit, ad ianuam properans.

source: With her left hand on the handle, she abruptly turned around, her eyes sparkling as she asked with a smile, “Do you want to have a child here?”
target: Manu sinistra in manubrio posita, subito versa est, oculis micantibus, et subridens quaesivit: “Visne hic infans habere?”

source: Lumian was taken aback.
target: Lumian obstupefactus est.

source: “Madame, aren’t you changing the subject too quickly?”
target: “Domina, num rem nimis citissime mutas?”

source: Noelia’s eyes held a maternal glint as she said with pity, “According to our assessment, the sea prayer ritual is at least as dangerous as a Saint or a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact when fully utilized for a short period.
target: Oculi Noeliae, maternum scintillam gerentes, dixerunt: “Secundum iudicium nostrum, rituale maris precationis saltem tam periculosum est quam Sanctus vel Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus I, cum ad breve tempus plene adhibetur.

source: I don’t know what you’re up to, but once you’re involved in this matter, you can’t escape just because you want to.
target: Nescio quid agas, sed quondam implicatus in hoc negotio, non poteris solum propter voluntatem tuam evadere.

source: Before that, have you considered leaving a descendant for yourself?
target: An prius contemplastī te ipsam posteritatem relinquere?

source: I can help you.”
target: Te adiuvare possum.

source: Are your Earth Mother Church’s combat nuns way of inviting someone to a one‑night stand so special?
target: Num vestrum modus monialium pugnacium Ecclesiae Matris Terrae aliquem ad unam noctem congressionem invitandi tam peculāris est?

source: Lumian was momentarily speechless.
target: Lumian momento mutus erat.

source: Noelia spoke sincerely, “Descendants are the continuation of our lives.
target: “Proles sunt continuatio vitārum nostrārum,” sincere voce Noelia dixit.

source: Flowers wither and fall to the ground, only to bloom into a more brilliant scenery the next year.
target: Flores marcescunt et in terram cadunt, ut post annum in scaenam clariorem renascant.

source: Are you really not considering having a descendant?”
target: Num vere non intentas posteritatem tibi generare?

source: “Not for now,” Lumian replied with a cold expression.
target: “Nunc non,” respondit Lumian vultu glaciali.

source: Noelia expressed regret, “Whenever you think it through, come to me.”
target: Noelia paenitentiam demonstravit: “Quotiescumque meditaveris, ad me veni.”

source: With that, she opened the door and walked out.
target: Hoc facto, ianuam aperuit et exiit.
